title: Energy guards; vorticity stretches
mathematical_role: Orient the reader to the distinction between energy control and three-dimensional vortex stretching.
learning_objective: See why the three-dimensional term (omega dot grad)u can amplify vorticity even while kinetic energy obeys its global dissipation law.
literal_semantics: The predecessor intends to contrast a global energy guard with a separate vorticity-stretching mechanism.
nonliteral_semantics: The closed eye-like loop is not a vortex tube or vortex line field.
The diagonal stroke is not a velocity gradient, strain eigenvector, or energy-cascade trajectory.
No visible thickness, length, or intensity is a computed vorticity quantity.
The image is not a Navier-Stokes simulation.

notes: Successor should link a staged vortex-tube geometry to the vorticity equation while keeping the energy identity in a separate analytic panel.

reproducibility_notes: The predecessor is not generated from a velocity/vorticity field or a recorded simulation.

accessibility.alt_text: Energy cascades downward while a vortex tube lengthens and thins under three-dimensional stretching.
accessibility.long_description: The predecessor does not actually show the vortex tube, lengthening, thinning, vorticity magnitude, or energy cascade named by its alternative text. The replacement must separate global energy control from a geometrically intelligible three-dimensional stretching sequence.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical orientation to the coexistence of energy dissipation and vortex-stretching difficulty in three dimensions.

supersession_reason: The current motif does not visibly represent the three-dimensional mechanism asserted by its title and alternative text.
